title: Family-Grouping Map (S4 matrix family-map readiness gate)
description: One recorded family-grouping map for an active OCR engine set, measured on a bake-off sample (same-wrong-string / paired-disagreement / gold-accuracy), never assumed from 'different software'. Tied to a matrix-policy version (the same policy_version string matrix-events-v1 entries carry). family_map_readiness flips true ONLY when family_diversity_count >= 2 over independent measured families AND an independent check (gold) anchored the measurement (lock section 3 conjuncts (i) and (ii); (iii) is this flag). A map measuring fewer than two independent families carries a contingency block and never flips readiness (arch D section 4 < 2-family contingency). The five ABBYY scan lineages count as one family.

policy_version.description: The matrix-policy version this map is tied to; the same string matrix-events-v1 entries carry.

input_sample_id.description: Identifier of the bake-off sample the independence was measured on (e.g. vol_01-bakeoff).

effective_date.description: The date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) this family map becomes the active policy. A pattern is used in addition to format because jsonschema does not enforce format without a FormatChecker.

engine_set.description: The active engine ids measured for this map.

family_groups.description: Independence blocks after declared-family collapse and measured-dependence collapse. Each block counts as ONE family.

family_diversity_count.description: Number of independent families (independence blocks). Must equal len(family_groups).

independent_check_present.description: Whether an independent check (gold) anchored the measurement (lock section 3 conjunct (ii)).

family_map_readiness.description: The gate flip (lock section 3 conjunct (iii)). True only when family_diversity_count >= 2 AND independent_check_present.

unmeasured_declared_engines.description: Engines that were in the declared active set but produced no evidence in the measured positions, so they do not count as families (measured, never assumed). Present only when non-empty.

allOf.comment: Fewer than two independent families REQUIRES a contingency block and forbids a readiness flip.

declared_families.description: The declared engine_family labels collapsed into this independence block.

merged_by_dependence.description: True when two or more declared-distinct families were merged here because their measured same-wrong-string cleared the dependence threshold.

dependence_threshold.description: Same-wrong-string rate at or above which two declared-distinct families collapse to one independence block. v1 default, tuning gated by the first-diagnostics embargo.

status.description: Why the map could not reach family-map readiness.

class1_blocked.description: Class-1 matrix training stays blocked; the bar is never relaxed to keep flowing.

recommended_action.description: arch D section 4: first bring Calamari into the bake-off and re-measure; if still < 2, weak-evidence table carries everything and the strict bar becomes a v2 revisit trigger.
